scripts.vercel-build: cd ../.. && npx turbo build --filter=@axon-tickets/api && node_modules/.bin/ncc build apps/api/dist/serverless.js -o apps/api/api --minify && (cp apps/api/api/client/libquery_engine-rhel-openssl-1.0.x.so.node apps/api/api/ 2>/dev/null || cp node_modules/.prisma/client/libquery_engine-rhel-openssl-1.0.x.so.node apps/api/api/) && (cp apps/api/api/client/libquery_engine-rhel-openssl-3.0.x.so.node apps/api/api/ 2>/dev/null || cp node_modules/.prisma/client/libquery_engine-rhel-openssl-3.0.x.so.node apps/api/api/) && (cp apps/api/api/client/libquery_engine-linux-arm64-openssl-3.0.x.so.node apps/api/api/ 2>/dev/null || cp node_modules/.prisma/client/libquery_engine-linux-arm64-openssl-3.0.x.so.node apps/api/api/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp apps/api/api/client/libquery_engine-linux-arm64-openssl-1.0.x.so.node apps/api/api/ 2>/dev/null || cp node_modules/.prisma/client/libquery_engine-linux-arm64-openssl-1.0.x.so.node apps/api/api/ 2>/dev/null || true) && echo '{"name":"axon-tickets-api-bundle","version":"0.0.1","private":true}' > apps/api/api/package.json
scripts.db:migrate: ts-node --transpile-only prisma/check-migrate-target.ts && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:prod: ts-node --transpile-only prisma/check-migrate-target.ts --allow-production && npx prisma migrate deploy
